# Savannah Foundation Repair Co

> Foundation repair and crawl space stabilization for homes in Savannah,
> Georgia and Chatham County. Free structural inspections with elevation
> readings and a written scope before any work is quoted.

Savannah sits on the coastal Lowcountry plain: sandy soil over a water table
only a few feet down. Homes here are raised crawl space or slab-on-grade –
basements are effectively non-existent – so the work is crawl space
stabilization, piering, slab leveling, crack repair and encapsulation rather
than the basement waterproofing common further inland.

## Services

- [Crawl Space Repair & Sagging Floor Jacks](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/crawl-space-repair): rotted joists and girders replaced, adjustable steel jacks set on poured footings. Locally commonly $1,300–$4,900.
- [Foundation Piering & Underpinning](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/foundation-piering): galvanized helical and push piers driven to load-bearing soil for settling foundations. Highest-ticket repair; several thousand dollars upward.
- [Concrete Slab Leveling](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/concrete-slab-leveling): sunken driveways, patios, walkways and garage slabs lifted with injected polyurethane foam, usually usable the same day.
- [Foundation Crack Repair](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/foundation-crack-repair): distinguishing structural from cosmetic cracking; epoxy/polyurethane injection, or stabilization first where movement is active.
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation & Dehumidifiers](https://www.savannahfoundationrepairco.com/services/crawl-space-encapsulation): sealed vapor barrier plus correctly sized dehumidifier to stop the ground moisture that rots framing.

Typical residential job: about $1,600–$4,100.

## Service areas

All of Chatham County, plus Richmond Hill (Bryan), Rincon and Springfield
(Effingham), and Hinesville (Liberty). Eighteen area pages, each covering what
actually fails in that specific place.
